steps.native_sql:
WITH invoice_versions AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID ORDER BY SEQUENCE DESC) AS RN
  FROM DMA_POWERBI.RAW.INVOICE_CDC
), payment_versions AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TENANT_ID, PAYMENT_ID ORDER BY SEQUENCE DESC) AS RN
  FROM DMA_POWERBI.RAW.PAYMENT_CDC
), invoices AS (
  SELECT * FROM invoice_versions WHERE RN = 1 AND NOT IS_DELETED
), payments AS (
  SELECT TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID, SUM(PAID_CENTS) AS PAID_CENTS
  FROM payment_versions WHERE RN = 1 AND NOT IS_DELETED
  GROUP BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID
), history AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, SEGMENT,
    CAST(VALID_FROM AS DATE) AS VALID_FROM, CAST(VALID_TO AS DATE) AS VALID_TO
  FROM DMA_POWERBI.RAW.CUSTOMER_HISTORY
)
SELECT i.TENANT_ID, i.INVOICE_ID, i.CUSTOMER_ID,
  CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE, i.STATUS, i.AMOUNT_CENTS,
  a.ADJUSTMENT_CENTS, COALESCE(p.PAID_CENTS, 0) AS PAID_CENTS,
  i.TENANT_ID || '|' || i.CUSTOMER_ID || '|' || TO_CHAR(h.VALID_FROM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CUSTOMER_HISTORY_KEY,
  i.TENANT_ID || '|' || i.INVOICE_ID AS INVOICE_KEY
FROM invoices i
JOIN history h ON i.TENANT_ID = h.TENANT_ID AND i.CUSTOMER_ID = h.CUSTOMER_ID
  AND CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) >= h.VALID_FROM
  AND (h.VALID_TO IS NULL OR CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) < h.VALID_TO)
LEFT JOIN payments p ON i.TENANT_ID = p.TENANT_ID AND i.INVOICE_ID = p.INVOICE_ID
LEFT JOIN DMA_POWERBI.RAW.ADJUSTMENTS a ON i.TENANT_ID = a.TENANT_ID AND i.INVOICE_ID = a.INVOICE_ID
